### 2026

- June 15, 2026: Our paper "[Rethinking the Green Power Grid for Stability, Not Just for Climate](https://www.cell.com/joule/fulltext/S2542-4351(26)00206-0)" was published in *Joule*.

- June 5, 2026: Our patent "[Method and System for Evaluating Synchronization Stability of Power Electronic Equipment](https://pss-system.cponline.cnipa.gov.cn/conventionalSearch)" was granted in China.

- February 2, 2026: Our patent "[Method and Apparatus for Monitoring Synchronous Safety and Stability of a Renewable Energy Grid-Connected System, and Computer-Readable Storage Medium](https://worldwide.espacenet.com/patent/search/family/078956840/publication/EP4203230A1?q=EP4203230)" was officially granted by the European Patent Office.

- January 16, 2026: Our paper "[Insights from Renewable Energy Outage Accidents Abroad for Secure and Stable Operation of Power Grids in China](http://dx.doi.org/10.7500/AEPS20230808004)" received the Annual Excellent Paper Award.

### 2025

- December 12, 2025: Our work "[Distributed Lyapunov Functions for Nonlinear Network Systems](https://ieeecss.org/event/64th-ieee-conference-decision-and-control)" was presented at the IEEE Conference on Decision and Control in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

- November 5, 2025: Our patent "[Method and System for Identifying Dominant Overvoltage of a High-Proportion New Energy Power System, Electronic Device, Storage Medium, and Computer Program Product](https://worldwide.espacenet.com/patent/search/family/085574702/publication/EP4350918A1?q=EP4350918)" was officially granted by the European Patent Office.

- September 16, 2025: Our patent "[Linearized Modeling Method and Apparatus for Renewable Energy Grid-Connected Systems Based on T-S Fuzzy Theory](https://pss-system.cponline.cnipa.gov.cn/conventionalSearch)" was granted in China.

- May 27, 2025: Our paper "[Distributed Lyapunov Functions for Nonlinear Networks](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCSYS.2025.3573881)" was published in *IEEE Control Systems Letters*.

- May 13, 2025: Our work "[Designing Disordered Oscillator Ising Machines for Global Optimization](https://www.petaspin.com/isingmachines2025/)" was presented at the International Workshop on Ising Machines.

- July 2024: Our paper "[Insights from Renewable Energy Outage Accidents Abroad for Secure and Stable Operation of Power Grids in China](http://dx.doi.org/10.7500/AEPS20230808004)" was published in *Automation of Electric Power Systems*.

- July 1, 2024: Our patent "[Method and System for Identifying Dominant Overvoltage of a High-Proportion New Energy Power System, Electronic Device, Storage Medium, and Computer Program Product](https://ppubs.uspto.gov/pubwebapp/)" was granted in the United States.

- June 6, 2024: Our paper "[Stability Boundary of Power System with Converter Interfaced Generation: Evolution and Transition Point](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10551510/)" was published online in *IEEE Transactions on Power Systems*.

- May 16, 2024: Our patent "[Method and Apparatus for Monitoring Synchronous Safety and Stability of Grid-Connected Renewable Energy System, Medium, Device and Program](https://ipsearch.ipaustralia.gov.au/patents/)" was granted in Australia.

- January 2024: Our paper "[Overvoltage of the Power System Integrated with High Proportion of Power Electronics (I): Definition, Classification and Relevant Requirements](https://doi.org/10.13334/j.0258-8013.pcsee.222401)" was published in *Proceedings of the CSEE*.
